title: antirez/ds4
claim: antirez/ds4 — DeepSeek 4 Flash and PRO local inference engine for Metal, CUDA and ROCm
why_good: From antirez (Redis's creator): a lean local inference engine for DeepSeek-4 across Metal/CUDA/ROCm. Pedigree + 19k★ / 1.7k forks / 39 contributors in weeks — people are actually running it.
value: The local-inference runtime is the toll booth for private, on-your-own-hardware AI — monetize via a supported/enterprise build, a hosted control plane, or a model marketplace on top.
risk: Inference engines are commoditizing fast (llama.cpp / vLLM); needs a durable edge beyond 'fast on Apple/AMD'.
